summary: Composes and sends a UDP heartbeat message. Builds the header "\heartbeat\%d\gamename\%s" (format string at 0x005E4ED8) into a 256-byte buffer from the game id at a1+228 and game name at a1+8; when a2 is non-zero appends a "\statechanged\%d" segment (format string at 0x005E4EC4). Sends the buffer via sendto using the socket at a1+4 against the peer sockaddr at a1+236 with length 16, then records the send time by storing GetTickCount() into a1+216 and returns it. Called from TickCountComparisonHandleInactivityTimeout (00561ed0).

operations.description: Build the heartbeat header into buf via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck with format string "\heartbeat\%d\gamename\%s" (0x005E4ED8), game id from a1+228 and game name from a1+8.
If a2 is non-zero, append the "\statechanged\%d" segment (format string 0x005E4EC4) to the message buffer at the current strlen position.
Send the assembled message via sendto using the socket at a1+4, the buffer, its strlen, zero flags, the peer sockaddr at a1+236 and length 16.
Record the send timestamp: store GetTickCount() into a1+216.
